verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents an SSO plugin that supports OIDC, OAuth2 and SAML 2.0. It also has an organization plugin with multi-tenancy, and the homepage claims enterprise SSO, SCIM and directory sync. However, nothing in the pack shows SSO connections being scoped to individual customer organizations, nor any domain verification or just-in-time user provisioning on first SSO login. Missing for 10: evidence of per-organization SSO connection binding, verified-domain support, JIT provisioning into organizations, and independent hands-on corroboration of enterprise SSO.
